description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the SubjectDeleted class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.policies package. It verifies immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and correct handling of null inputs related to the SubjectDeleted event.

classes.name: SubjectDeletedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the SubjectDeleted event, covering immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and null argument handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the SubjectDeleted class instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations for SubjectDeleted.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating a SubjectDeleted instance with a null policy ID string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a SubjectDeleted instance with a null PolicyId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLabel
methods.description: Ensures that creating a SubjectDeleted instance with null label throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullSubject
methods.description: Ensures that creating a SubjectDeleted instance with null subject ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method produces the expected JSON representation of a SubjectDeleted instance.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a SubjectDeleted instance from JSON and verifies its fields.
